segments.tha-ap182:5.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā saṅghupaṭṭhāko thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.

lines: So ekadivasaṃ “pubbe mayā kiṃ nāma kammaṃ katvā ayaṃ lokuttarasampatti laddhā”ti attano pubbakammaṃ saritvā paccakkhato jānitvā somanassajāto pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pākaṭaṃ karonto vessabhumhi bhagavatītiādimāha.
Tattha ahosārāmiko ahanti ahaṃ vessabhussa bhagavato sāsane ārāmiko ahosinti attho.
Sesaṃ heṭṭhā vuttanayattā uttānatthattā ca suviññeyyamevāti.

before.title: Saṅghupaṭṭhākattheraapadānavaṇṇanā
lines: Ayampi thero purimabuddhesu katakusalasambhāro anekesu bhavesu vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puññāni upacinanto vessabhussa bhagavato kāle tassārāmikassa putto hutvā nibbatto viññutaṃ patvā saddho pasanno vihāresu ārāmikakammaṃ karonto sakkaccaṃ saṅghaṃ upaṭṭhāsi.

So teneva kusalakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto ubhayasampattiyo anubhavitvā imasmiṃ buddhuppāde sāvatthiyaṃ gahapatikule nibbatto vuddhippatto vibhavasampanno sukhappatto pākaṭo satthu dhammadesanaṃ sutvā sāsane pasanno pabbajitvā vattasampanno sāsanaṃ sobhayamāno vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhento nacirasseva saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ patto chaḷabhiñño pubbe katakusalakammavasena saṅghupaṭṭhākattheroti pākaṭo ahosi. 45.
